reason: Read RL12 supplier statements and proofs; Kleshchev Proposition 3.1.4 pp38–39 and §3.2 pp39–41. Use the terminal-power proof on the single triple (only e_i v=0 is required) to derive m in Z>=0 and the exact m+1 nonzero-independent string. The commutator formula gives e_i f_i^k v=k(m-k+1)f_i^{k-1}v, and s_i(eta-k alpha_i)=eta-(m-k)alpha_i. Distinguish a cyclic finite string from the entire intersection of an arbitrary integrable module support with eta+Z alpha_i, which can be infinite.
